description: Frozen synthetic mechanics cohort for serial-F32 versus packed-Q8 comparisons. Cases have no ground-truth labels and cannot establish accuracy. Ambiguous wording does not guarantee a near-tie model output. Timings include instrumentation and are descriptive, not a latency distribution. Serial depth batches may use F32 activations; packed projection rows use Q8. Thresholds are diagnostic, not deployment policy.
